name: NUSC 3230
title: Community Nutrition
description: (Also offered as DIET 3230.) An introduction to public health and community-focused issues in food and nutrition. Topics will center public health infrastructures, behavior change, determinants of health, and more.
requirement_description: NUSC 2200; open to junior or higher Dietetics, Nutritional Sciences, and Allied Health Sciences majors; others by consent.
